steps.title: Set up public connection with Read content only
steps.detail: In the Developer portal, create a public connection, note its client ID and set its redirect URI. Set Read content as the only content capability.
steps.doneWhen: Connection shows a client ID and redirect URI, with Read content as its only content capability.

evidence.quote: 1 Navigate the user to the connection’s authorization URL. This URL is provided in the Developer portal .
Parameter Description Required client_id An identifier for your connection, found in the connection settings. ✅
To set your connection’s capabilities see the Authorization guide or navigate to the Developer portal . For PATs, choose capabilities when you create the token.
If your connection is reading data to export it out of Notion, your connection will only need Read content capabilities.

steps.title: Implement redirect callback and code-to-token exchange (not executed)
steps.detail: Read the code query parameter from the redirect. Exchange it at the token endpoint using Basic auth with client credentials and grant_type authorization_code.
steps.doneWhen: Callback and token exchange code exists in the test app. No authorization has been executed yet.

steps.title: Authorize a test-workspace user and exchange the code
steps.detail: Open the authorization URL from the connection settings as the test user. Select two or three test pages in the page picker, then complete the redirect and token exchange.
steps.doneWhen: Redirect returns a code, the token exchange succeeds, and only the selected test pages are shared.
